# 4RinLabs

> 4RinLabs is a creative digital studio and software company specializing in AI development, SaaS platforms, web applications, mobile apps, and custom software solutions for startups and enterprises worldwide.

## Company

- **Name:** 4RinLabs
- **Website:** https://www.4rinlabs.com
- **Email:** 4rinlabs@gmail.com
- **Type:** Software Development Company / Creative Digital Studio

## Core Services

### AI Development
Custom AI solutions built for production. Services include:
- Large Language Model (LLM) integrations (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini)
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems
- AI Agents and multi-agent architectures
- Workflow automation with AI
- Computer vision projects
- Chatbots and conversational AI
- Prompt engineering and model fine-tuning

### Custom Software Development
Bespoke software engineered around client workflows:
- Internal tools and dashboards
- Enterprise software systems
- API development and integrations
- Database architecture and optimization

### SaaS Development
End-to-end SaaS platform development:
- Multi-tenant architecture
- Subscription billing (Stripe integration)
- User management and authentication
- Analytics and reporting dashboards
- MVP to enterprise scale

### Web Development
Full-spectrum web development:
- Static and dynamic websites
- Marketing and landing pages
- E-commerce stores
- Portfolio sites
- Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS

### Mobile App Development
iOS and Android application development:
- React Native cross-platform apps
- Native mobile development
- App Store and Play Store submissions
- Push notifications, offline-first, performance optimization

### WhatsApp CRM
WhatsApp Business API solutions:
- Automated lead qualification flows
- Broadcast messaging systems
- CRM integrations (HubSpot, custom)
- Support ticketing via WhatsApp

### Digital Marketing
Performance-driven digital marketing:
- Social media management
- Meta and Google Ads campaigns
- SEO and content strategy
- Brand growth consulting

## Technology Stack

Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
Backend: Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM
AI/ML: OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector)
Mobile: React Native
Cloud: Vercel, AWS, GCP
Auth: Auth.js (NextAuth)

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is 4RinLabs?**
4RinLabs is a creative digital studio that builds AI solutions, SaaS platforms, web applications, and custom software for startups and enterprises worldwide.

**What AI services does 4RinLabs offer?**
We build custom AI systems including LLM integrations, RAG pipelines, AI agents, multi-agent architectures, chatbots, computer vision systems, and workflow automation.

**How long does a project take?**
A focused marketing site may ship in 2-4 weeks. Larger products and AI systems typically run 6-12 weeks with clear milestones.

**Do you work with startups?**
Yes. We work with startups from MVP validation through scale, as well as established enterprises needing custom software or AI capabilities.
